items.name: Blitar Cube Fasting 2017

venue.name: STIEKEN (Sekolah Tinggi Ilmu Ekonomi Kesuma Negara)
venue.address: Jalan Mastrip No. 59, Kepanjen Kidul, Kota Blitar, Jawa Timur 66117
venue.details: The location is around 500 m from the blitar Train station

items.information: Blitar Cube Fasting 2017 is an official event at Blitar city that coincide with fasting month. The payment will be done on the spot with registration fee of 70.000 IDR for all events. The organizers also provide "takjil" (food) to break the fast. For further information you can contact the organizers.

items.information: This competition is held for fund-raising purpose. The participants would be limited to 160 people and walk-in registration is not allowed. The first event would be RM 25, and RM 5 would be charge for the subsequent events.

items.name: Maoming Open 2017
items.information: The limitation is 150 participants, based on a first-come-first-serve rule. For Chinese domestic participants, a completed registration is online registration plus prepaid registration fee. For oversea participants, if you can't pay the fee online, pls contact the delegate. Then we will make a reservation for you and you can pay the fee by cash on-the-site. Please check the competition website for registration and the other information.

items.name: UCSD Summer 2017
items.information: * The cost of registration is a $15 flat fee. Payments are taken after registering. * Registration closes May 31st at 11:59 PM PDT; please be sure to register before then! * We will not be taking registration at the door. There is an 75 competitor limit.
